summary: Kresus is a self-hosted personal finance manager designed to help you track your money, budgeting, and overall financial management. It provides a centralised web interface to record transactions and view your financial status over time. As a personal tool, it runs entirely on your own infrastructure under an open source licence.
goodFor: It is a good fit for single users who want to host their own money management tool and keep their financial data off third-party servers.
watchOut: Development activity is currently slowing down, which may impact how quickly bugs are fixed or new bank synchronisations are added. The AGPL-3.0 licence also places strict copyleft requirements on any network-accessible modifications you make.
deployNotes: Since it runs on Node.js and is packaged for Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volume storage for your financial data and put it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS. You should also check the documentation to see if it requires a separate database container or manages state locally.
